en.title: Longest Subarray
en.description:
Given an array of positive integers, find the length of the longest contiguous subarray whose sum does not exceed k.

This site's input protocol and the explicitly stated supplementary ranges are compiled by CSWork and do not pose as the original OA rules.
en.input: The first line contains n k (1≤n≤100000, 1≤k≤10^9); the second line contains n positive integers a[i] (1..1000).
en.output: Output the maximum length of a subarray with sum ≤k; output 0 if no non-empty subarray qualifies.
en.explanation: See the accompanying solution for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: Positive values allow a sliding window: add elements at the right end, and while the sum exceeds k keep removing elements from the left end, tracking the maximum length of a valid window.
